article.story: FAIRBORN, Ohio -- — Dominic Pangonis' 30 points led Wright State over Air Force 102-71 on Monday night in a season opener. Pangonis added three steals for the Raiders. Andrea Holden scored 20 points and grabbed 11 rebounds while shooting 7 of 10 from the field and 5 for 6 from the line. Noah Lewis had 15 points and finished 7 of 8 from the floor. Kam Sanders and Grant Best each finished with 17 points for the Falcons. A.J. Patterson had 12 points. Wright State led 60-31 at halftime, with Pangonis racking up 27 points. Kellen Pickett scored all 13 points of his points for the Raiders after the break. Up next Wright State plays Friday against Florida Atlantic at home, and Air Force hosts Calumet on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
